about: Discover DevMania’s mission, vision and approach to websites, apps and SaaS development in Dubai.

ABOUT US

Ideas with purpose.
Products with impact.

DevMania is a digital development company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We build websites, mobile applications and SaaS products that help businesses connect with customers and simplify everyday work.

Our mission

To turn business ideas into practical, accessible digital products through thoughtful design, reliable development and clear collaboration.

Our vision

To be a trusted digital partner for businesses ready to grow, making useful technology accessible and helping ideas become lasting products.

How we work

We start by understanding the problem and the people using the product. We define a focused scope, build and test the experience, then refine it as needs evolve.

privacy: How DevMania handles enquiries, analytics and information entered into its website tools.

DEVMANIA

Privacy Policy

What information this website uses and why.

Who Handles Your Information

Alain Badran operates DevMania from Dubai, United Arab Emirates. For privacy questions, access requests or deletion requests, contact support@dev-mania.com.

Information We Receive

When you contact us, we receive the details you choose to share, such as your name, email, phone number, project requirements and files. Hosting services process technical information such as IP addresses, request details and security logs. Google Analytics is installed to measure website visits and interactions and may use cookies or device identifiers.

Project Planning and AI

When you request AI generation, the product type and idea text are sent to our server and OpenAI to generate a brief. The request asks OpenAI not to store the response; this does not eliminate provider processing or any retention under its own policies. Do not enter passwords, payment details or sensitive personal information. Browser session storage keeps some preferences, project filters and draft enquiry content while you use the site.

How We Use Information

We use enquiry details to respond, prepare proposals and deliver agreed work. Technical information supports website operation and security. Analytics helps us understand how the website is used. We do not sell your personal information.

Providers and External Links

The website uses Cloudflare hosting, Google Analytics and OpenAI for the relevant features. Email, WhatsApp, Instagram, app stores and linked project sites apply their own privacy policies when you use them. Information may be processed outside your country. We share information with providers as needed to operate these features or where legally required.

Payments

This website does not currently collect card details through a general DevMania checkout. If payments are introduced, the named payment provider will process the transaction under its own privacy policy. Do not send card numbers or security codes to us by email or WhatsApp.

Retention and Your Choices

We retain enquiry and project records for as long as needed to respond, deliver work and meet applicable record keeping obligations. You can request access, correction or deletion, subject to those obligations. Browser controls can restrict cookies and clear session data; blocking analytics may affect measurement but does not prevent contacting us.

Security and Updates

We use reasonable safeguards for information we handle, but no internet service is completely secure. Updates will be published here with a revised effective date.

Effective 12 October 2026

refunds: DevMania refund and cancellation terms for development projects and software purchases.

DEVMANIA

Refund Policy

Clear cancellation and refund terms before purchase.

How to Request Help

Email support@dev-mania.com with your order or invoice reference, purchase date and reason for the request. Please do not include card details. We aim to acknowledge requests within three business days.

Custom Development Projects

If you cancel before work starts, payments for work not performed are refundable, excluding third party costs you expressly authorized and which cannot be recovered. Once work starts, we assess completed work against the agreed scope and return any unearned balance. The project agreement may specify milestones and acceptance procedures. Disputed or incomplete deliverables are reviewed with you rather than treated as automatically nonrefundable.

Software Licenses and Subscriptions

Contact us within 14 days of your initial purchase to request a refund. We review the product terms, access or use, and the reason for the request. This is a review window, not an unconditional refund guarantee. If the software cannot provide a material advertised function and we cannot resolve the problem, we will consider an appropriate refund or other remedy. Specific product policies and mandatory consumer rights take precedence where applicable.

Subscription Cancellation

Cancel through the product account, payment provider or by contacting support before the next renewal. Cancellation stops future billing; access normally continues until the end of the paid period unless the product terms state otherwise. Renewal refunds are reviewed individually, including duplicate or incorrect charges.

Payment Processing

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method where possible. Processing time depends on the payment provider and bank. If a merchant of record handled your purchase, its applicable refund process and buyer terms also apply.

Your Rights

This policy does not limit statutory cancellation, refund or other consumer rights that apply to your purchase. For a concern about an agreed project, contact us so we can review the scope, delivery and payment records together.

Effective 12 October 2026
